title: Complexity transition in the Dicke model of light-matter interaction
summary: Tuning the coupling strength $g$ of an interacting quantum system may drive a sudden change in its ground-state or thermal properties. To identify and grasp non-analytical, or even discontinuous, transitions in far-from-equilibrium dynamics proves more challenging. Recently Krylov complexity $C_K$ has offered fresh insights about operator growth, thermalization, and chaos in quantum dynamics. Yet it remains unclear if, and how, changing $g$ can trigger a sharp transition in the complexity measures.
